meta.titleV: AI photo to video — 3D motion from one picture, free — cv.cm
meta.descV: Turn one photo into a moving 3D video: AI depth runs in your browser, the camera pushes in, orbits or pans, and you download an MP4. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, nothing is uploaded.

v.name: AI photo to video
v.blurb: One picture becomes an MP4 with a 3D camera move.

v.q1: How does photo to video work?
v.a1: An AI model (Depth Anything V2) estimates how far each part of the picture is. A virtual camera then moves through that depth, so near things shift more than the background, like a short 3D shot.
v.a2: No. The model downloads once (about 25–100 MB, depending on your device) and runs in this tab. The video is encoded in the browser too.
v.q3: Can it make a video from text?
v.a3: No. It animates a picture you already have: a photo, a drawing or an AI image. People and objects do not move on their own; the camera moves.
v.q4: Which format and size is the video?
v.a4: MP4 at 30 fps, 3, 5 or 8 seconds, 720p or 1080p (never more than the photo's own pixels), in the photo's shape or cropped to 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9. It plays on phones and uploads to TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
v.a5: The camera reveals a little of what was hidden behind near objects, and the tool fills it from nearby pixels. Pick Subtle, or a photo with a clear subject and a plain background.

v.title: AI photo to video
v.privacyNote: AI depth and video encoding run in this tab. Your photo is never uploaded.
v.dropHint: Or paste. The preview starts moving at once.
v.hint: The camera moves through the photo's AI depth.
v.note: The camera moves, not the people in the photo.
v.waitDepth: Wait a moment: the 3D depth is still being made.
v.errorGl: This browser cannot draw WebGL 2, which the 3D preview needs.
v.errorEncode: This browser cannot encode video. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.

v.lead: Make a short 3D video from one photo in this tab.
v.s1b: Drop or paste a picture. AI works out its depth in a few seconds and the preview starts moving.
v.s2b: Push in, pull out, orbit, pan or rise. Set the strength, length, shape (9:16 for Reels and Shorts) and quality.
v.s3b: The video is encoded in the browser and saved as an MP4 you can post anywhere.
